result.reason: The clause gives Customer the preferred affiliate and M&A/successor assignment carve-out and creates no termination right on Customer change of control. However, it does not expressly prohibit Contractor from assigning to a Customer competitor, as required by the preferred position. It also does not reach the fallback because the successor carve-out is not mutual. The changes are otherwise limited and professionally drafted; the margin comment cannot cure the missing operative restriction.
